stem: Which statement best explains the significance of the Mayflower Compact?

options.label: F
options.text: It limited the power of future colonial governments.

options.label: G
options.text: It weakened the influence of religion in government.

options.label: H
options.text: It established a form of self-government based on a social contract.

options.label: J
options.text: It guaranteed liberties for colonists through local government.
